author: Lindsay Ellis
description:
This video was originally produced as a Nebula Original, but in light of Dolly's passing we've decided to post it here for two weeks as well. You can donate to Dolly's Imagination Library through the YouTube giving feature attached to this video or here: https://donate.imaginationlibrary.com/

Follow-up Dollywood video will be on Nebula on Friday. 
Nebula page: https://nebula.tv/lindsayellis
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/lindsayellis
title: Yes, Dolly was Actually That Great
